paper_title: On the Complexity of Lattice Puzzles
classifications: Theory of computation → Problems, reductions and completeness
statement: We also mention that we focus on the problems that ask if a given set of plates has a feasible state or not in this paper. That is, we do not ask if the feasible state can be assembled even if each plate is rigid. Like the sliding block puzzles, allowing the “movement of pieces”, the assembling puzzle of rigid plates can be PSPACE-complete. Is there a variant of the lattice puzzle with movement which gives us a characterization of PSPACE-completeness?
context: Although we show several results, we still have many unsolved problems. Especially, computational complexity of the simplest problem on 2n plates of size 1 × (n + 1) in the one-sided fit model is open. By Theorems 2 and 3, it seems that this problem exists between the NP-complete problem and the GI-complete problem.
